# Amware Fulfillment (now part of Staci)

Amware Fulfillment (now part of Staci) is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Staci Americas is a fulfillment and distribution company with 18 locations in the US and Europe. They offer services in fulfillment, ecommerce, retail compliance, marketing and POS fulfillment, promotional products, direct sales, transportation, reverse logistics, and more. They cater to various industries such as health and wellness, pharma, cpg, food and beverage, fashion and luxury, cosmetics and beauty. Amware Fulfillment (now part of Staci) employs 191 people (-5.9% YoY, -12 people) and has an annual revenue of $200M. Headquartered in Lawrenceville, Georgia, United States, with offices including Jersey City, Cranbury, Avondale, Dallas, and Bolingbrook. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

## About

Amware Fulfillment has rebranded as Staci Americas -- the US arm of the Staci Group's global fulfillment network. Amware was purchased by Staci in March of 2023. Follow Staci Americas on LinkedIn. 

As Staci Americas, the company will continue to help companies scale order fulfillment operations so these brands can grow without limitations. Staci Americas fulfillment network includes 18 US facilities across 8 campus locations (Phoenix, Dallas, Atlanta, Chicago, New Jersey, Los Angeles, Reno, Memphis) covering more than 2 million square feet of space. In total, Staci operates a network of 80+ multichannel fulfillment centers across the US , Europe and Asia.
